aliases: 8MP (4K) Network Explosion Proof Fixed AI Camera

power.method: Camera only: PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at, Class 4), 13.6W max; camera & heaters: PoE++ (IEEE 802.3bt), 90W max

storage.notes: Micro SD/SDHC/SDXC 2 slots, max 1TB each (2TB total).

features: Powder-coated aluminum housing (RAL2000) made in USA, NEMA Type 4X
AI object detection (person, face, vehicle, license plate) with attributes, BestShot, slip & fall, face mask, social distancing
AI people/vehicle/crowd counting, queue management, heatmap
extremeWDR 120 dB, WiseNR II, SSNR V, DIS, defog
Built-in mic, selectable mic/line in, line out; RS-485; 2 configurable alarm I/O
ONVIF S/G/T/M, SUNAPI, Hanwha Vision Open Platform, MQTT
Secure element (FIPS 140-3 level 3, CC EAL6+), SBOM, Wisepower power monitoring, power redundancy failover
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision datasheet (DataSheet_TNO-P9082EPT1-Z_260101_EN.pdf). Power consumption is the 90W camera+heater maximum (camera only 13.6W). MJPEG limited to 5fps at 8MP. Direct cloud connection listed as supported.

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.
